name: Fuji Oil Holdings Inc.
summary: Fuji Oil Holdings Inc. makes and supplies food ingredients worldwide. Its products include vegetable oils and fats such as hard butters for chocolate, confectionery and frying oils, and fats for frozen desserts, along with industrial chocolate, soy protein, soymilk products and soluble soy polysaccharides. The company dates from 1950 and has its head office in Osaka, Japan.
